character_sheet: A player-shaped companion: the vanilla biped - a head with a hat layer, a body, two slim 3-wide arms and two legs (ModelGirlfriend.java:15-41, the HumanoidModel layout on a 64x32 sheet) - drawn with one of 41 numbered skins, a dandelion cycling them (Girlfriend.java:94, :117-119, :554-562; GirlfriendRenderer.java:42-44), and wearing whatever armour she is given (:576-585; GirlfriendRenderer.java:20-23). She is a tameable fighter: 80 HP, speed 0.3, 8 damage plus her held weapon (:355-360); a poppy tames her one time in three (:528-552), her owner's food heals her and a weapon or armour equips (:564-598), an empty hand takes an item back or toggles her sitting (:600-612). Tamed, she follows her owner (:183-188), hunts creepers within 20 and monsters within 15 blocks (:246-272), is jealous of untamed rivals near her owner (:279-280) and, with a weapon in hand, swings it every 25 ticks within 4 blocks - 10 with Big Bertha (:434-453) - taunting within 7 (:454-465); at range she shoots an Ultimate Arrow from the Ultimate Bow or throws a shoe every 20 ticks within 10 blocks (:197, :489-522). Between 14000 and 22000 of the day she dances on a floor of gold, diamond, emerald, ruby, amethyst, titanium or uranium blocks - ten moves of strafes, hops, crouches, arm swings and turns, synchronised with the girlfriends beside her (:193-194; MyEntityAIDance.java:58-75, :186-284). On February 14 she is a 2.5 x 8 giant with 800 HP who hunts players and boyfriends until a Rose Sword cures her (:126-162, :211-212, :653-668). She floats, panics, opens doors and shelters indoors (:198-206), heals 1 per 100 ticks (:392-398), takes at most 10 per hit and ignores cactus (:641-670). Read her as a player character: the Steve walk, a weapon swing, a shoe throw, the dance.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig (GirlfriendRenderer.java:19, a HumanoidMobRenderer; x5 while valentine-angry, :27-33; shadow 0.5) on a 64x32 sheet (ModelGirlfriend.java:41); the hitbox is 0.5 x 1.6, or 2.5 x 8.0 as the valentine giant (ModEntities.java:519-522; Girlfriend.java:156-162). A HumanoidArmorLayer draws the vanilla armour models over the same bones (GirlfriendRenderer.java:20-23). Skins: girlfriend0-40 and girlfriendv (GirlfriendRenderer.java:35-45) - one rig for all.

labels.head: head (turns and pitches with the look)
labels.hat: hat layer (an inflated copy of the head; the vanilla model copies the head's pose onto it)
labels.right_arm: right arm (a slim 3-wide arm; swings with the stride, sways at rest, carries the weapon swing)
labels.left_arm: left arm (a slim 3-wide arm; swings with the stride, sways at rest)

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: legs: 1.4 rad (80 deg) x the walking speed; arms: 2.0 x 0.5 = 1.0 rad (57 deg) x the walking speed, each arm opposite its own side's leg; no threshold
groups.plain: the vanilla biped walk: the legs stride in opposition and the arms swing against them, the stride phased by the distance walked rather than by time
groups.math: right_leg.xRot = cos(limbSwing * 0.6662) * 1.4 * limbSwingAmount; left_leg.xRot = cos(limbSwing * 0.6662 + pi) * 1.4 * limbSwingAmount; right_arm.xRot = cos(limbSwing * 0.6662 + pi) * 2.0 * limbSwingAmount * 0.5; left_arm.xRot = cos(limbSwing * 0.6662) * 2.0 * limbSwingAmount * 0.5
groups.source: vanilla HumanoidModel.setupAnim (net.minecraft.client.model.HumanoidModel; ModelGirlfriend.java:9 extends it with no override)
groups.phase: phase from distance walked: limbSwing x 0.6662 (one stride every 9.4 units of distance), not time
groups.omega_note: not time-based: the vanilla walk cycle advances with limbSwing (the distance walked), so it has no natural period in ticks; the contract's walk loop is scaled by speed in-game as any gait group

groups.name: arm_sway_roll
groups.amplitude: 0.05 rad (3 deg) around a 0.05 rad rest, the two arms in opposition (a slight outward sway)
groups.plain: at all times the arms sway gently outward and back about the shoulder, in opposition
groups.source: vanilla HumanoidModel.setupAnim (ModelGirlfriend.java:9 extends it with no override)
groups.omega_note: the vanilla idle sway: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.09 = 69.8 ticks

groups.name: arm_sway_pitch
groups.amplitude: 0.05 rad (3 deg), the two arms in opposition, added to the gait's pitch
groups.plain: a second, slower sway of the arms fore and aft, in opposition
groups.source: vanilla HumanoidModel.setupAnim (ModelGirlfriend.java:9 extends it with no override)
groups.omega_note: the vanilla idle sway (a sine): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.067 = 93.8 ticks

behaviour: The port's ModelGirlfriend adds no motion of its own: it is the vanilla HumanoidModel (ModelGirlfriend.java:9, no setupAnim override), so the biped's standard rules pose it - the head turns and pitches with the look, the hat copies the head; the legs stride at 1.4 rad x the walking speed and the arms swing against them at 1.0 rad x the walking speed, both phased by the distance walked (limbSwing x 0.6662) rather than by time; at rest the arms sway 3 degrees outward (cos at 0.09/tick) and fore-and-aft (sin at 0.067/tick) in opposition.

The vanilla swing plays on the main arm whenever the entity swings: the held-weapon melee calls swing(MAIN_HAND) before every hit (Girlfriend.java:441-442), the ranged attack swings after each shot or throw (:521), and the dance's moves 4, 5, 6, 9 and 10 swing the used hand every ten ticks (MyEntityAIDance.java:231, :239, :244, :262, :277); the vanilla arm poses for a held item and a drawn bow apply as for a player; the dance's crouch moves (3, 7, 8, 9, 10: setShiftKeyDown, :226, :249, :255, :261, :275) put her in the vanilla sneak pose.
The armour layer draws the vanilla armour models over the same seven bones (GirlfriendRenderer.java:20-23), so every bone keyed here moves her armour with her.

The skin, not the pose, carries her states: 41 numbered skins and the valentine texture (GirlfriendRenderer.java:35-45); the synched values (DATA_SKIN, DATA_VOICE, DATA_VOICE_ENABLE, DATA_FEELING_BETTER, Girlfriend.java:79-88) are skin, voice and the valentine cure, not an attacking flag. The valentine giant is a x5 render scale and a 2.5 x 8 hitbox (GirlfriendRenderer.java:27-33; Girlfriend.java:156-162), the same rig.

There is no rig to package today: ModelGirlfriend (the vanilla biped) has no entry in tools/reference_model_proofs.json (TEST-010), so no reference-leg geo exists and the generator lists the species as unpackaged; the bone names above are the createBodyLayer names (ModelGirlfriend.java:19-39) and will be the rig's when it is covered.

formulas: vanilla `HumanoidModel.setupAnim` (net.minecraft.client.model.HumanoidModel, NeoForge 21.1.223, HumanoidModel.java:137-286 by the jar's line table; ModelGirlfriend.java extends it with no override - the probe's classic side is its transcription `ModelGirlfriend.poseFrom` -> `HumanoidClassicPose.setupAnim` (HumanoidClassicPose.java, the same bytecode statement by statement) after the renderer's three field sets; the classic renderer is a HumanoidMobRenderer - orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:386 `new RenderGirlfriend(new ModelBiped(), 0.5f)`, vanilla ModelBiped in 1.7.10 too): the head yaws by the look yaw in degrees times 0.017453292 and pitches by the look pitch the same way (a quarter turn down while gliding on an elytra, which a tameable never does); the legs pitch by the cosine of the walk position times 0.6662, times 1.4, times the walking speed - the right leg, and the left leg with the phase advanced by pi - and yaw and roll by 0.005 (the right) and -0.005 (the left); the arms pitch by the cosine of the walk position times 0.6662 (the left; plus pi for the right), times 2, times the walking speed, times 0.5, and yaw 0; while seated on a vehicle (a boat or a minecart) both arms pitch a further -0.62831855 and the legs take -1.4137167 of pitch, 0.31415927 (the right) / -0.31415927 (the left) of yaw and 0.07853982 / -0.07853982 of roll; the arms bob at all times - each rolls by the cosine of the age in ticks times 0.09, times 0.05, plus 0.05 (the right positive, the left negative) and pitches by the sine of the age times 0.067, times 0.05 (the right positive, the left negative); during a swing - the attack progress above 0, the renderer's `getAttackAnim(partialTick)` read at the FRAME's partial tick, which the seam now carries (PoseInputs.partialTick) - the body yaws by the sine of the square root of the progress times two pi, times 0.2 (negated for a left-handed swing), both arms are re-placed 5 units along that yaw and yaw with it, and the swinging arm pitches down by the sine of a smoothed progress times pi, times 1.2, plus the sine of the progress times pi, times minus the head pitch less 0.7, times 0.75, yaws by twice the body yaw and rolls by the sine of the progress times pi, times -0.4; the hat copies the head. The swim branch (visually swimming with a swim amount above 0, `getSwimAmount(partialTick)`) and the crouch never occur for this mob. The walk position phases the stride and the age the bob. The GeckoLib hook is the same (GirlfriendGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations, delegating to BoyfriendGeoReplacement.poseRig), the two per-frame lerps at the seam's partial tick.
